items.headline: 3 Rock Island County fire protection districts to work together as South Rock Fire
items.summary: Each district will remain autonomous with separate boards and local control over collected tax dollars. Response, training and planning will be done as a team.

items.headline: Galesburg to seek additional class action settlements surrounding PFAS contamination
items.summary: In 2021, the city joined a class action against companies the city said contributed to elevated PFAS levels in the Oquakwa wells.

items.headline: Davenport fundraiser raising money for local pancreatic cancer patients
items.summary: You're invited to the annual fundraiser in memory of Dr. Brent Ohl on Saturday, Oct. 24. The money will go towards helping local pancreatic cancer patients.

items.headline: MercyOne Genesis in Davenport becomes site of Iowa's newest Safe Haven Baby Box
items.summary: The boxes allow parents to anonymously surrender custody of infant children. MercyOne's box is the fifth in Iowa.

items.headline: Study finds Illinois’ Displaced Energy Workers Bill of Rights falls short
items.summary: Non-union workers at a southern Illinois coal mine didn’t receive the same benefits as unionized workers, the study found.

items.headline: Police: Man shot in the chest in Rock Island
